reasons: Direction is correct: the Termination Payment under Section 4.2 is payable solely by the Company (our client, the customer under this hosting agreement) to HDI (the host/vendor), with 4.2(b) expressly confirming no reciprocal payment — squarely a Customer-payable liquidated exit charge caught by rule LD.

Redline implements the preferred position with a clean, coherent edit: full deletion of 4.2(a)-(c) (p0026-p0029) and its sub-heading (p0025), plus a conforming change to the Section 4 heading (removing 'Termination Payment.') so no dangling reference remains; Section 4.1's term/termination mechanics are untouched.

Comment is accurate and correctly characterizes the formula (50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000), the one-way nature, and the trigger on any Company termination including termination for HDI's default; it cites the playbook position and offers the sanctioned fallback (single early-termination fee capped at three months' fees, convenience terminations only) in the required concise first-person-plural tone with the [Playbook] prefix.
Deterministic checks all pass; the 0.500 changed-character ratio on p0023 is merely the heading conformance required by the deletion and does not indicate over-editing.
